meta.name: market-entry
meta.description: Decides whether and how to enter a new market — sizing demand from the bottom up rather than from a market report, testing whether your advantage transfers, choosing between organic entry, partnership and acquisition, sequencing the operational and regulatory work that entry actually requires, and setting the criteria that would tell you to stop. Use this to evaluate a new geography, segment or vertical, pressure-test an entry plan, or work out why a launched market never reached scale.

copy.tagline: 判断该不该进新市场,并规划进入路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正打算进入新地区或新行业,想先验证机会再投入。
copy.tagline_en: Assess a new market opportunity and plan your entry strategy.

howto.what: Claude 会帮用户从可统计的客户数量等自下而上估算市场规模，检验既有优势能否转移到新市场，比较有机进入、合作、收购三种模式，列出运营与监管成本清单，并在启动前设定停止条件。
howto.when: 当用户要求评估新地区、细分市场或垂直领域，压力测试进入计划，或分析已进入市场为何没做起来时触发。

say.text: 帮我从下往上估算德国中小企业的需求规模，再对照市场报告。
say.note: 会用量化客户数与支出构建估算。

say.text: 我们想进入东南亚，检验产品优势能否转移过去。
say.note: 会追问具体可转移的优势与同行未做原因。

say.text: 计划在日本设团队，列出运营成本并设定停止条件。
say.note: 会要求给出实体、合规清单与退出标准。

howto.what_en: Claude estimates market size from countable units, tests whether your advantage transfers, weighs organic vs partnership vs acquisition, lists operating and regulatory costs, and sets exit criteria before launch.
howto.when_en: When you ask to evaluate a new region, segment or vertical, pressure-test an entry plan, or diagnose why a launched market underperformed.

say_en.text: Help me size German SME demand from the bottom up and compare with the report.
say_en.note: It will derive the estimate from countable clients and spending.

say_en.text: We plan to enter Southeast Asia — will our product advantage carry over?
say_en.note: It will ask for the specific advantage and why incumbents haven't done this.

say_en.text: List operating costs and set stopping criteria for our Japan launch.
say_en.note: It will request entity, compliance items and a written exit condition.
